author: emilizzle
body:
Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed)
Pantai
The reason you were temp-banned/banned
Teamgriefing using TNT
Why you should be unbanned from the server.
It was not my intention to teamgrief, I liked that map but the big hill was in front of where I was going to start a good skybridge. So I decided to blow the hill up with 4 stacks of TnT. I saw this tactic on youtube before and it is really nice for you team if the map is a bit more organised.

I also want to be able to play the mini tournament this Saturday.

Sorry if I accidentally killed someone with the tnt (I think not because I placed the tnt on the side where none was at that moment) or if someone got lagspike from the TnT.
